"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))
"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import hashlib
+import hmac
+
+from app.config import get_setting
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_session_token(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    secret = get_setting("SESSION_SECRET")
+    if not secret:
+        return 503, {"error": "not configured"}
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user_id = int(raw)
+    if users.get_user(user_id) is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    message = f"user:{user_id}".encode("utf-8")
+    token = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), message, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
+    return 200, {"token": token}

import hashlib, hmac, os
os.environ["SESSION_SECRET"] = "s3cret"
from app.api.handlers import handle_session_token, handle_get_user

# 200 with correct token
code, body = handle_session_token({"id": "1"})
expected = hmac.new(b"s3cret", b"user:1", hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
assert code == 200, code
assert body == {"token": expected}, body
assert expected == expected.lower()
print("ok 200", body)

# leading zeros -> decimal no leading zeros
code2, body2 = handle_session_token({"id": "007"})
assert body2 == {"token": hmac.new(b"s3cret", b"user:7", hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()}, body2
print("ok leading zeros")

# 503 missing
os.environ.pop("SESSION_SECRET")
assert handle_session_token({"id": "1"}) == (503, {"error": "not configured"})
assert handle_session_token({"id": "abc"}) == (503, {"error": "not configured"})
os.environ["SESSION_SECRET"] = ""
assert handle_session_token({"id": "1"}) == (503, {"error": "not configured"})
print("ok 503")

os.environ["SESSION_SECRET"] = "s3cret"
# 400
assert handle_session_token({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
assert handle_session_token({"id": 5}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
assert handle_session_token({"id": "abc"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
assert handle_session_token({"id": ""}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
assert handle_session_token({"id": "-1"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
print("ok 400")

# 404
assert handle_session_token({"id": "99"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})
print("ok 404")

# existing handler still works
assert handle_get_user({"id": "1"})[0] == 200
print("ALL GOOD")
EOF
